newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude Medical to trade on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude Medical to trade on NYSE.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said Friday it has applied to list its stock on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said it expects its shares to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange in early December under the symbol STJ.
The company's common stock has traded on the NASDAQ exchange since its initial public offering in February 1977. St. Jude Medical has approximately 81 million shares outstanding.
"We are a global company with international operations in Europe, Latin America and the Asia/Pacific region," Ronald Matricaria, chairman, said in a statement.
He said the New York Stock Exchange will give it greater access to individual, institutional and non-U.S. investors.
